## UFP Packaging Launches All Boxed Up as Brand for Growing Corrugated Business


October 13, 2026


[PDF Version](https://www.ufpinvestor.com/node/31446/pdf)


The brand gives UFP Packaging's corrugated business a distinct identity and brings its products, capabilities and manufacturing locations under one name.


GRAND RAPIDS, Mich.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[UFP Packaging](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795684-1&h=1902446855&u=https%3A%2F%2Fufppackaging.com%2F&a=UFP+Packaging) , North America's leading industrial packaging manufacturer, today announced the launch of[All Boxed Up](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795684-1&h=1435164393&u=https%3A%2F%2Fallboxedup.com%2F&a=All+Boxed+Up) , a dedicated brand for its corrugated packaging business.


The launch comes as UFP Packaging continues to expand its corrugated business, including the addition of its Las Vegas manufacturing facility in mid-2026.


"As our corrugated business has grown, we have seen an opportunity to give it an identity that more clearly reflects the products, capabilities and customer relationships behind it," said Scott Worthington, president of UFP Packaging. "All Boxed Up presents our customers with a clearer picture of the full-service corrugated partner we've become while giving us a stronger foundation for continued investment in the industry."


"All Boxed Up gives our teams a brand that better represents the work we do," said Nick Hoffman, vice president of UFP Packaging. "For our customers, the name makes it easier to recognize our corrugated capabilities while knowing the people behind the operation remain the same."


The brand will roll out across customer-facing channels, including the website and building signage. Customers will continue to work with the same teams and receive the same products and services they rely on today.


The All Boxed Up name originated with a[corrugated packaging business UFP Packaging acquired in 2022](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795684-1&h=2002791876&u=https%3A%2F%2Fufpi.com%2Fufp-packaging-acquires-titan-corrugated-and-its-affiliate-all-boxed-up%2F&a=corrugated+packaging+business+UFP+Packaging+acquired+in+2022) . It will now represent the company's full corrugated product offering, including stock boxes, custom mailer boxes and point-of-purchase displays, as well as its manufacturing locations.


**About UFP Packaging**


UFP Packaging is a leading North American provider of industrial packaging solutions and the largest producer of wooden pallets and crates in the United States. With expertise in metal fabrication, corrugated conversion and labeling, UFP Packaging offers a full range of packaging services, positioning itself as a comprehensive provider. Headquartered in Grand Rapids, Mich., UFP Packaging is a subsidiary of UFP Industries, Inc. (Nasdaq: UFPI).
